R4 requires run.json.suite_revision and run.json.suite_sha256 to equal the pinned suite, but those run.json fields are null. The byte-bound subject manifest carries the exact suite revision/hash.

Independent artifact inspection found executables at `<runRoot>/evidence/<runId>/targets/{reference,candidate}/...`; R4 checks for `<runRoot>/targets/...`. The validator would reject these otherwise valid paths after its earlier run/manifest predicate is corrected.
